# Landing page clarity check

## When to use

- Review my landing page for clarity
- Is this hero section too jargon heavy for a first-time visitor
- Smell test the copy on our product page
- Does a stranger understand what we sell in five seconds
- Critique the headline and subhead on this marketing site
- "does this landing page make sense to someone outside our industry"

## Procedure

1. Read the page as a stranger with zero context.
2. List every term a visitor would have to already know.
3. Score the headline, subhead, and first call to action for plain language.
4. Return a ranked list of clarity fixes with rewritten copy.

## Caveats

Do not assess conversion mechanics, pricing tables, or checkout flows. See references/rubric.md for the scoring rubric.
